premise.title: Demo Saga
premise.premise: A small company of travelers carries a sealed message across two lands to the one person who can read it.
premise.setting: Two neighboring lands joined by a single mountain pass.

magic.magicSystem: Four elements answer anyone who studies them, at the cost of stamina.
magic.weatherTie: Rain strengthens water, snow weakens fire.

villain.villain: The Warden, keeper of the pass.
villain.motive: Believes the message will start a war.

protagonist.protagonist: The Courier, who promised to deliver the message.

members.name: Courier
members.past: Ran messages between villages for ten years.

members.name: Scholar
members.past: Studied the elements at a quiet school.

members.name: Guard
members.past: Served a town watch until it disbanded.

chapters.name: The Lowlands
chapters.summary: The message is handed over and the journey begins.

chapters.name: The Far Shore
chapters.summary: Across the pass, the message finds its reader.

endings.name: Kept
endings.concept: The Courier keeps the message sealed.

canon.statement: Only one mountain pass joins the two lands.

fields.label: Weapon class
fields.help: For example sword, staff, or claw. Equipment with the same class can be worn.

fields.label: Stat leanings
fields.help: Relative strengths. One is average, two is double.

fields.label: Limit tree
fields.help: Limit breaks in unlock order.

fields.label: B storyline
fields.help: The personal subplot that runs under the main story.

fields.label: Move
fields.help: Optional tactics seam: tiles per turn.

fields.label: Element
fields.help: Empty means non elemental.

fields.label: Charge ticks
fields.help: Wind up before the action lands. Zero is instant.

fields.label: Formula
fields.help: Empty uses the ruleset formula set for this kind.

fields.label: Range
fields.help: Optional tactics seam.

fields.label: Area
fields.help: Optional tactics seam.

fields.label: Effect
fields.help: The ability that fires when the item is used.

fields.label: Weapon class
fields.help: Weapons only. Matches a character weapon class.

fields.label: Gear tier
fields.help: Compared with the Expected Party State gear tier.

of.label: Links
of.help: Each link is a pair of slot numbers counted from zero, such as 0 and 1.

fields.label: Gauge effect
fields.help: Freeze stops the gauge. Empty resets it each tick.

fields.label: Duration in turns
fields.help: Zero lasts until cured.

fields.label: Template
fields.help: A built in template. Leave empty to write an expression.

fields.label: Expression
fields.help: Used when no template is chosen. Variables: a.<stat>, a.level, t.<stat>, t.level, power, p.<param>.

fields.label: Parameters
fields.help: Read in expressions as p.<name>.

fields.label: Absorbs its own type
fields.help: Its own element heals it instead of being resisted.

fields.label: Default affinity
fields.help: Computed from the type and the relation table: its own type is resisted and its opposite is the weakness.

fields.label: Rules
fields.help: Checked top to bottom. The first rule whose condition holds acts.

of.label: Parameter
of.help: A fraction such as 0.35, a count such as 2, or a status ID for status conditions.

fields.label: Real world phenomenon
fields.help: For example supercell thunderstorm or radiation fog.

fields.label: Target win rate
fields.help: Percent. The Simulator draws this as the target line.

fields.label: AP thresholds
fields.help: AP needed to reach each level after the first.

fields.label: Support effect
fields.help: Support materia only: how it modifies its linked neighbor.

fields.label: Rumor
fields.help: What townsfolk say.

fields.label: Strategy
fields.help: The plan in words. The rules below are what the engine runs.
